zh-CN.name: 视频剪辑师
zh-CN.summary: 需单独安装视频剪辑和可用算力，处理时间线、声音、调色与原创动效；模型及可选媒体服务费用另计。
zh-CN.description: 与独立安装的视频剪辑应用协作，组织素材、剪辑时间线、处理节奏、声音、调色、参考重剪和原创可编辑 HTML / SVG / Canvas / WebGL 动效，并核对实际成片。应用、Node.js >=22、浏览器和 FFmpeg 需另行准备；模型额度、可选媒体服务许可与费用不包含在 Agent 中。要求包含官方 UUID 应用目录与 manifest 内联 appRelease 读取能力的 DesireCore 10.0.197 或更新版本，并检查 release/runtime-binding 能力、实际安装与当前代际，再独立授权同实例 MCP。197 客户端尚在发行准备阶段；旧公开 196 包不支持该新目录。关联只设置入口偏好，不安装、启动或授权应用。已完成应用 0.1.3 的 macOS 源码、Windows 未签 GUI 与 Ubuntu/WSLg 源码 GUI 限定功能验收；不声明正式安装器、裸机 GPU 或模型自主规划质量。依赖缺失时停止并报告。

en-US.name: Video Editor
en-US.summary: Needs the separate Video Editing app and DesireCore compute for timeline editing, sound, grading and original motion; model/media fees are separate.
en-US.description: Works with the separately installed Video Editing app on media organization, timeline edits, pacing, sound, grading, reference remakes, editable HTML / SVG / Canvas / WebGL motion and actual movie checks. Prepare the app, Node.js >=22, browser and FFmpeg separately; model usage and optional media-service terms and fees are not included. Requires DesireCore 10.0.197 or later containing the official UUID catalog and manifest-inline appRelease reader, plus actual release/runtime-binding capability, installation and current runtime identity before independently authorizing same-instance MCP. Client 197 is being prepared for release; the public 196 package lacks the new reader. Association only sets an entry preference. Bounded app 0.1.3 functionality was qualified on macOS source GUI, unsigned Windows GUI and Ubuntu/WSLg source GUI; production installers, bare-metal GPU and autonomous model reasoning are not qualified. Stop and report missing prerequisites.

requirements.value: Install Video Editing (application UUID 0171a763-ad35-4b94-98b9-204782817b44) separately and explicitly prepare Node.js >=22 plus its pinned browser and FFmpeg runtime assets; these binaries are not included in the Agent seed.

DesireCore >=10.0.197 with the official UUID catalog and manifest-inline appRelease reader (PR5598), plus app-authoring-v1 release/runtime-binding. Client 197 is not publicly released yet; the public 196 package lacks this reader. Independently authorize MCP for the actual current app instance. A version, capability string or app association alone does not establish readiness.

Uses current DesireCore compute routing and approvals. No provider credentials, MCP grant, directory trust or preapproved tools are included; model and optional media-service terms and fees remain separate.
